missing.detail: Astra K Sports Tourer 1.4 ECOTEC CNG (110 PS, 08/2017-04/2019): ADAC lists 540 l normal / 1630 l dachhoch, so no volume loss from the CNG tanks (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/opel/astra/k/283245 and .../k/293139). This can be added as a cng variant with trunkL 540, trunkFoldedL 1630, and removed from notFound.

Astra H Caravan before the facelift (10/2004-02/2007): ADAC lists 505 l normal / 1540 l dachhoch (e.g. Caravan 1.8 10/04-12/05, https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/opel/astra/h/998878; Edition 11/04-12/05 .../h/201268), with the same wheelbase of 2703 mm and height of 1500 mm. The generation's 500/1590 l comes from the facelift (2007-2010) entries only. Consider adding a pre-facelift variant (yearTo 2007) with trunkL 505 and trunkFoldedL 1540, or noting the difference.

Corsa D 1.4 LPG ecoFlex (Autogas, 07/2009-11/2010, 5-door): ADAC lists 285 l / 700 l fensterhoch / 1100 l dachhoch, the same as the generation (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/opel/corsa/d/219948/). This is an optional LPG variant.
Astra H 1.6 ecoFLEX LPG (2009, factory LPG) exists according to a third-party catalogue (mobile.md). No trunk figure was found. This is an optional variant.

verification.notes: Third-party databases (auto-data.net, angurten.de, fastcarcheck, ultimatespecs, auto-motor-und-sport) and ADAC confirm all dimensions and trunk figures for Astra H/J/K, Astra J/K Sports Tourer and Corsa C-facelift/D/E (5-door). No Opel press data sheets were found. Unresolved: angurten.de gives 1804 mm width without mirrors for the Astra H 5-door and the Astra H Caravan, while ADAC, autoscout24, cars-data and a period press-style source give 1753 mm. No manufacturer source settles it, so 1753 is kept and counted as unconfirmed for the Caravan only. Astra J Sports Tourer folded volume is 1540 l in some databases (fastcarcheck) and 1550 l in ADAC/auto motor und sport; 1550 is kept. Corsa D 5-door width 1737 mm (3-door 1713 mm) per ADAC. ADAC's Astra J 1.4 LPG review text says the tank in the spare-wheel well raises the floor, yet the ADAC data entry keeps 370/1235 l, so that is left unchanged. Corsa E width 1746 mm (5-door) is confirmed by auto-data/ADAC; angurten.de's 1736 mm matches the 3-door. Generation year ranges are plausible. No important missing German-market generations; OPC/GSi versions are 3-door or GTC only and excluded by design.
